meta.title: Gloaming — Come back to the English you want to read
meta.description: Gloaming is an AI reading environment for authentic English. It won't interrupt your reading or turn it into tasks. AI appears only when you need it.

hero.title: Come back to the English you want to read.
hero.subtitle: Gloaming is an AI reading environment for authentic English. It won't interrupt your reading or turn reading into tasks. AI appears only when you need it—to help you understand, explore, and keep going.

origin.title: Why we built Gloaming
origin.paragraph1: Traditional English reading is often broken by dictionaries and translation apps. Every unfamiliar word becomes a roadblock, and immersion fragments.
origin.paragraph2: We believe language grows through real, sustained input—not task lists. Reading should be the goal, not a means to an end.

contrast.title: Authentic English reading shouldn't be this hard.
contrast.pastItem1: Stop to look up words and lose the thread
contrast.pastItem2: New words feel like memory chores
contrast.punch: AI isn't a teacher. AI isn't a chatbot. AI is a quiet reading companion.

philosophy.title: Read first. Learn along the way.
philosophy.lead: Your goal is not to complete lessons. Your goal is to stay with the text.
philosophy.authenticBody: Read real English—not simplified textbook passages.
philosophy.focusBody: No progress bars or streak pressure—just reading.
philosophy.assistBody: Context help when you need it; silence when you don't.

product.title: An AI environment designed around reading.
product.readerBody: Focused reading. Comfortable type. Clean layout. Less visual noise.
product.companionBody: Understand words. Explain sentences. Add background. Keep the flow.
product.companionCardBody: Contextual explanation of the selected text, helping you understand the nuance without leaving the page.
product.shelfBody: Save what you're reading. Pick up where you left off.

friction.title: Less friction while you read.
friction.lead: AI exists to protect reading—not replace it.

invite.title: Rediscover the joy of reading English.
invite.body: Gloaming wants to be a bridge between you and English. We hope you're here for the love of reading—not to finish another task.
